cues.en: We've gone through step one problem definition.
cues.zh: 已經介紹第一步，定義問題。

cues.en: We've gone through step two data.
cues.zh: 也介紹第二步，資料。

cues.en: And step three, we've defined what success means for us.
cues.zh: 第三步定義了成功的意義。

cues.en: Now let's get on to step four, which is features.
cues.zh: 現在是第四步，特徵。

cues.en: Now here, the question we're trying to answer is what do we already know about the data?
cues.zh: 要回答的是，對資料已經知道什麼？

cues.en: Now, if you haven't worked with data before, you might hear this word features and be wondering what the hell does features mean?
cues.zh: 如果沒處理過資料，可能聽到 features，會想到底是什麼？

cues.en: Well, you'll hear this world come up a lot in machine learning, maybe in the form of feature learning or feature variables.
cues.zh: 機器學習常出現這個詞，例如特徵學習或特徵變數。

cues.en: Or when someone asks How many features are there?
cues.zh: 也可能有人問，有幾個特徵？

cues.en: Or What kind of features are there?
cues.zh: 或有哪些特徵類型？

cues.en: Features is another word for different forms of data.
cues.zh: 特徵就是資料裡不同形式的資訊。

cues.en: Now we've already discussed different kinds of data, such as structured and unstructured, but features refers to the different forms of data within structured or unstructured data.
cues.zh: 先前談過結構化與非結構化資料；特徵則指這些資料內部的不同資訊形式。

cues.en: For example, let's go back to our predicting heart disease problem.
cues.zh: 例如回到心臟病預測。

cues.en: We might want to see if things such as a person's body weight, their sex, their average resting heart
cues.zh: 可能想看體重、性別、平均靜止心率，

cues.en: rate and their chest pain rating can be used to predict if they have heart disease or not.
cues.zh: 與胸痛評分，能否預測有沒有心臟病。

cues.en: These three things a patient's body weight sex, average resting heart rate and chest pain are features of the data.
cues.zh: 講者說這幾項：體重、性別、平均靜止心率與胸痛，就是資料的特徵。

cues.en: They could also be referred to as feature variables.
cues.zh: 也可以叫特徵變數。

cues.en: In other words, we want to use the feature variables.
cues.zh: 也就是說，希望使用特徵變數，

cues.en: To predict the target variables, which is whether or not a person has heart disease or not.
cues.zh: 預測目標變數，也就是有沒有心臟病。

cues.en: Now when it comes to feature variables, again, there are different kinds.
cues.zh: 特徵變數也有不同類型。

cues.en: You've got numerical, which means a number like body weight.
cues.zh: 數值型，例如體重這種數字。

cues.en: There's categorical, which means one thing or another, like sex or whether a patient is a smoker or not.
cues.zh: 類別型，代表某種類別，例如性別、是否吸菸。

cues.en: And then there's derived, which is when someone like yourself looks at the data and creates a new feature using the existing ones.
cues.zh: 還有衍生特徵，也就是你查看資料後，使用現有特徵建立新的。

cues.en: For example, you might look at someone's hospital, visit history timestamps, and if they've had a
cues.zh: 例如查看就醫紀錄的時間戳記，如果過去一年，

cues.en: visit in the last year, you could make a categorical feature called Visited in last year.
cues.zh: 有就醫，就建立類別特徵，叫「過去一年曾就醫」。

cues.en: If someone had visited in the last year, they would get true.
cues.zh: 有就醫就設為 True。

cues.en: Or in our case, yes.
cues.zh: 這裡用 yes。

cues.en: If not, they would get false.
cues.zh: 沒有就設為 False。

cues.en: Or in this case, no.
cues.zh: 這裡是 no。

cues.en: The process of deriving features like this out of data is often referred to as feature engineering.
cues.zh: 從資料衍生特徵的過程，常稱為特徵工程。

cues.en: Our heart disease example is structured, but unstructured data has features too.
cues.zh: 心臟病例子是結構化資料，但非結構化資料也有特徵。

cues.en: They're just a little less obvious.
cues.zh: 只是沒那麼明顯。

cues.en: If you looked at enough images of dogs, you'd start to figure out, okay, most of these creatures have four shapes coming out of their body, their legs, and a couple of circles up the front.
cues.zh: 看夠多狗照片，就會發現大多有四個從身體伸出的形狀，也就是腿，前面還有兩個圓形。

cues.en: Their eyes.
cues.zh: 就是眼睛。

cues.en: As a machine learning algorithm looks at different images, it would start to learn these different shapes and much more and figure out how different pitches are similar or different to each other.
cues.zh: 演算法查看不同影像後，會學到這些形狀和更多特徵，找出照片之間的相似與差異。

cues.en: Don't worry when it comes to figuring out the different patterns between features such as the four rectangle
cues.zh: 別擔心，要找出特徵模式，例如從狗身體伸出的四個長方，

cues.en: sort of shapes coming out of a dog's body or the circles at the front of the dog's head.
cues.zh: 形狀，或頭部前面的圓形，

cues.en: You don't have to tell the machine learning algorithm what they are.
cues.zh: 不需要你告訴演算法它們是什麼。

cues.en: The beautiful thing is it figures them out on its own.
cues.zh: 好處是，它會自行找出來。

cues.en: The final thing to remember is a feature works best within a machine learning algorithm.
cues.zh: 最後記住，特徵在許多，

cues.en: If many of the samples have it for now.
cues.zh: 樣本都有提供時，演算法才能發揮較好效果；回到，

cues.en: Predicting heart disease problem.
cues.zh: 心臟病預測問題。

cues.en: Say we had a feature which was called most Aden Foods, which had a list of the foods the patient ate
cues.zh: 假設有個「最常吃的食物」特徵，列出患者，

cues.en: most often, but only 10% or ten out of 100 patient records had it.
cues.zh: 最常吃的食物，但只有 10%，也就是 100 筆患者紀錄裡的 10 筆有填。

cues.en: So this one ID for patient ID for 3 to 8 has most in food, which is Fry's not ideal, and these other
cues.zh: 這個患者 ID 這裡有填，最常吃的是薯條，不太理想；其他，

cues.en: patients don't have it because remember, only ten out of 100 examples have the most eaten food.
cues.zh: 患者沒有，因為 100 個範例只有 10 個有這項資訊。

cues.en: They have data here, so these ones are just missing and that'll be the same.
cues.zh: 有些有值，這些則缺漏，其餘也一樣。

cues.en: So if you can imagine, there's 100 patients here, only ten of them will have this most eaten food column field.
cues.zh: 想像這裡有 100 位患者，只有 10 位的「最常吃的食物」欄位有填。

cues.en: And since the machine learning algorithm learns best when all samples have similar information, we either leave this one out or try to collect more information before using it.
cues.zh: 演算法在所有樣本資訊相似時學得最好，所以先排除這個特徵，或蒐集更多資訊再用。

cues.en: The process of ensuring all samples have similar information is called feature coverage in an ideal data set.
cues.zh: 確保所有樣本都有相似資訊，稱為特徵覆蓋率；理想資料集，

cues.en: You've got complete feature coverage.
cues.zh: 會有完整的特徵覆蓋。

cues.en: So for us to want to to be able to use this feature of most eating foods, ideally we'd want all values
cues.zh: 要使用「最常吃的食物」特徵，理想上希望這些，

cues.en: here, or at least more than 10% coverage, which means that over 10% or over ten and 100 examples have some sort of value in this column.
cues.zh: 值都有填，至少超過 10% 覆蓋率，也就是 100 個範例裡，超過 10 個在這欄有值。

cues.en: We'll have plenty of practice looking at different features in coming lectures and projects and lessons.
cues.zh: 之後的講座與專案，會大量練習查看不同特徵。

cues.en: In the meantime, think about a problem you had to solve recently.
cues.zh: 先想想最近解決過的問題。

cues.en: What features went into it?
cues.zh: 用了哪些特徵？

cues.en: Were they numerical or categorical, or did you combine them into your own derived feature?
cues.zh: 是數值、類別，還是組合成自己衍生的特徵？
